title: Answer-driven learning loop: automatic cause records per wrong answer and held-out gain table (REQ-0084)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 explain reproduces the manual causes

design.summary: run-stats explain (deterministic cause checks per wrong or flagged answer, no key letters in output), run-stats gain with Wilson and held-out reading rules, board flags, rate-limit stop fix, process rule for answers

implementation.summary: pipeline/explain.py (join, extraction/context/path/solver checks, primary cause), run-stats explain and gain, board flags, rate-limit message stops the run; replay reproduces 2025 manual causes (7 of 7) and 2026 (24, 63, 65, 112; 38 mismatch noted)

unit_test.result: 1573 tests, only the 4 known baseline failures (final run before the last 3-test rate-limit change; test_exam_llm and test_explain re-run after it); key leak audit 0; default output byte-identical to 32dcdf9; 7 mutations caught; hand checks of 5 causes agree except 2026 Q38 (tool unknown, honest)
